content.text:
Home Manager has no `programs.podman` module. Its native option is `services.podman.enable`; it installs Podman, but it is not CLI-only: on macOS it declaratively creates and maintains a Podman VM (and removes unmanaged Podman machines), while Linux defaults to an image auto-update timer.

That conflicts with your earlier “CLI tooling only” choice, so I need you to choose the intended behavior.

questions.question: Which enable-controlled Podman setup should I add?

options.label: Native service (Recommended)
options.description: Use services.podman.enable; installs Podman and lets Home Manager manage its macOS VM/Linux service behavior.

options.label: CLI-only wrapper
options.description: Add a local programs.podman.enable option that only installs the package; no VM, timers, or config.

options.label: Keep package list
options.description: Leave the current direct package entry without an enable option.
